Specification_and_Requirement: Must represent unmodeled high-frequency climate residuals (interannual velocity pulses, storm-driven calving anomalies).
Implementation_Rule: Must NOT model secular multi-decadal trends; secular trends are the exclusive domain of the physical dynamic backbone.
Mathematical_Enforcement: Mean-zero prior: E[Delta D_ML] = 0 over multi-decadal windows; L2 ridge penalty on non-zero bias.

Specification_and_Requirement: Physical discharge D_total(t) cannot be negative (ice cannot flow backwards up mountains).
Implementation_Rule: Hard truncation: D_total(t) = max(0.0, D_physics(t) + Delta D_ML(t)).

Specification_and_Requirement: Cumulative ML residual drift must not corrupt long-term ice volume.
Implementation_Rule: Bounded residual magnitude: |Delta D_ML(t)| <= 0.25 * D_physics(t). Residual cannot exceed 25% of deterministic physical flux.
Mathematical_Enforcement: Box constraint / hyperbolic tangent saturation: Delta D_bounded = 0.25 * D_physics * tanh(Delta D_raw / (0.25 * D_physics)).

Specification_and_Requirement: In 2050–2100 under SSP5-8.5, climate forcings will exceed historical 1979–2024 training domain.
Implementation_Rule: Epistemic uncertainty must expand; ML residual mean must decay to zero (reverting to pure physics) as Mahalanobis distance increases.
Mathematical_Enforcement: Gaussian Process / Bayesian shrinkage: Delta D_ML -> 0 as ||x_future - x_train|| -> infinity; sigma_residual -> sigma_max.

Specification_and_Requirement: Audit finding: Pure ML failed in Phase 4. Adding ML prematurely to Phase 5 risks masking physical errors.
Implementation_Rule: MANDATORY TWO-STAGE IMPLEMENTATION: (1) Evaluate pure physical dynamic backbone standalone; (2) Only add ML residual if physical backbone exhibits unmodeled white-noise residuals.
Mathematical_Enforcement: Stage 1 benchmark report required before Stage 2 ML coupling is authorized.
